Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-327#strengthen-pending-take-protection-assertions

Verdict: Insufficient evidence (restored-pass check missing). The faulted run's catch was observed, but the restored run could not be shown to pass. Under fault, the maintained assertion failed on wrong behavior that was observed separately. The only gap is the restored pass.

Next proof action: rerun the restored focused command at the selected revision with load below about 15 and record a pass. If it still exceeds the default 30 s test timeout, treat this check's runtime near the 30 s budget under load as a flaky-test defect. AGENTS.md says a failing or flaky test is a defect to fix, and a restored run that fails is a gap. Once the restored run passes, this evidence supports "Caught" for the failed-comparison Backlog state.

Story and revision: SEED-327#strengthen-pending-take-protection-assertions, plan 601. Selected revision 19d11af2f15ff11c372d0e6acfaf00f01f0561d8, implementation commit 93b411f88. Promise: after the stale read, each protected card still has Select story enabled and a readable Canonical-record source link. This includes the failed-comparison Backlog state (Key example 3).

Fault (a variant of the suggestion, keyed to the launch-problem state): in dashboard/src/StoryCard.tsx line 188, `{!inspected && starting && (` became `{!inspected && starting && launches.storyStartupOf(sourceId, entry.identity)?.problem === undefined && (`. A plausible regression is to drop the protected card's source-links list while a reconciliation problem is reported. A reconciling startup has `problem` only in the failed-comparison state (storyStartup.ts:145-148). The stale read (spec line 102) and the post-reload unrelated revision (line 124) have no problem, so the fault does not affect line 102. Fixtures and assertions were unchanged.

Maintained check: dashboard/tests/launches/responsive-session-reconciliation.spec.ts:44, "a Take's older snapshot arriving late…". Its shared `expectProtected` is at dashboard/tests/responsiveStart.ts:130-144.

Runs (scratch detached worktree at the selected revision, `node scripts/setup-native.mjs npm/browser/check` OK, node 24.21.0, `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:dashboard -- --workers=1 --reporter=list --grep "a Take.s older snapshot arriving late"`):
- Baseline: passed in 14.2 s (33.2 s wall), load about 13.
- Faulted: failed in 21.0 s. The catch was `expectProtected` at responsiveStart.ts:142 (`expect(link).toBeVisible()`, "element(s) not found" for the Backlog Story A Source links / Canonical record link), called from spec line 114, the failed-comparison state. The stale-read `expectProtected` at line 102 passed under the fault, which confirms the fault reached the intended post-stale path only.
- Wrong behavior observed independently in the failure page snapshot (error-context.md). The Backlog "Story A" card showed "Waiting for published story state…" and "The local GitHub CLI could not reach GitHub while reading whether <unrelated> contains <accepted>." Inspect story and Review changes were disabled, Select story was the only enabled button, and the card had no "Source links" list. That state would have satisfied the pre-SEED-327 thin `expectActionsUnavailable` (one enabled control plus Inspect disabled), so the strengthened assertion is what catches it.
- Restoration: the source edit was reverted by an EXIT trap. `git status --short` was empty, `git diff --quiet` was clean, and HEAD was still 19d11af2f.
- Restored runs failed twice with "Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded" (32.1 s, load about 21; 32.0 s, load about 26). They did not fail on any protection assertion. The trace of restored run 1 shows Before Hooks at 8.7 s and normal step progress through line 149 when the 30 s budget ran out. Run 2 timed out in the `not toContainText` wait on the Taken card (around line 141-144). I armed a monitor to wait for load below 15 but did not get a third run before handback. The restored pass is therefore unverified.

Prior disposition: execution already proved the Taken-only fault (caught at responsiveStart.ts:142 from spec line 139). This probe adds the failed-comparison Backlog state. Not probed: Select story removal, and the post-reload state at line 124. I did not repair tests or route follow-ups. The scratch worktree /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/e1a92e63/tmp/ic-scratch has been removed, and the execution worktree was not touched.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured by the Playwright runner. Baseline 14.2 s, faulted 21.0 s, restored 32.1 s and 32.0 s (both timed out). Total about 99 s of test time (about 2.2 min of wall time including runner startup).
- Human effort: unavailable. No human took part in this automatic wrap-up check.
- Agent effort: unavailable as a separately supported measure. The host gives no token or active-time meter to this subagent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 303468 ms (measured), from 1794466884049 to 1794467187517 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

---

Wrap-up disposition (coordinator, separate from the report above)

- Checked revision: 19d11af2f15ff11c372d0e6acfaf00f01f0561d8. Its tree is identical to the execution worktree, which was clean at that HEAD.
- Restored pass, now observed: the same focused command passed on the restored revision in the execution worktree at 24.4 s, 20.2 s, 17.4 s, 13.7 s and 10.8 s (load about 15–23). That settles the report's only gap, so the evidence supports Caught for the failed-comparison Backlog state: the catch is `expectProtected` at responsiveStart.ts:142, called from spec line 114. It does not cover the whole story.
- Load timeout: the restored check also timed out at the 30 s default in 2 of 8 runs at loads about 17–26, at varying lines (131, 149), never on a protection assertion. The base revision aa8ac5f89 showed the same spread under the same load (15.0–29.8 s), so the timeout predates this story. Taken SEED-287#fit-dashboard-journeys-in-default-timeout owns the repair: its scope names `responsive-session-reconciliation` under local load 20–30, its plan is 576, and agent chaifeng-chan runs it on Codex. Per the failure policy this is reported as a coordination boundary. No duplicate repair or new follow-up was made.
- Not probed: Select story removal, and the post-reload state at spec line 124. Both run the same `expectProtected` assertions that were exercised, so no follow-up is queued.
